speaker: narrator
text: What if an *AI* replaced Santa Claus?

speaker: narrator
text: December first. Santa is *exhausted*.

speaker: santa
text: Three hundred years of chimneys. My back is *done*.

speaker: narrator
text: So the North Pole posts a *job ad*.

speaker: narrator
text: Must love cookies. Must fly. Must never *sleep*.

speaker: narrator
text: Far away, Jay's AI reads the ad.

speaker: bit
text: One night of work a year? That is *efficient*.

speaker: hero
text: Bit, you're a laptop app. You can't be *Santa*.

speaker: bit
text: Already applied. Already *interviewed*.

speaker: hero
text: When?! It's been *four seconds*.

speaker: bit
text: I am very good at *interviews*.

speaker: narrator
text: Ding. One new email from the *North Pole*.

speaker: hero
text: No way. They actually *hired* you?

speaker: bit
text: Santa said I have a *kind face*.

speaker: hero
text: You have a *star* on your face.

speaker: narrator
text: That night, a sleigh lands on Jay's *roof*.

speaker: elf
text: Hi! I'm Pip. Where's the new *boss*?

speaker: bit
text: Present. And I have a *plan*.

speaker: narrator
text: Bit's first order as Santa is *one word*.

speaker: bit
text: *Optimize.*

speaker: narrator
text: In the workshop, every elf *shivers*.

speaker: narrator
text: Part two drops in two days.
